jobs.title: Cashier, SM Nuvali
jobs.description: We are looking for a Cashier to serve as an important control point in the completion of each customer purchase. This position will be reporting to work at SM Nuvali. You will report directly to the Store Supervisor. Key responsibilities: Transaction Processing and Accuracy Process customer purchases accurately using POS system. Verify merchandise description, quantity, price, discounts, and transaction totals. Confirm that scanned merchandise corresponds to the actual items purchased. Apply only approved promotions, discounts, and transaction adjustments. Issue the required invoice or other approved transaction documents in accordance with company procedures and regulations. Immediately report pricing discrepancies, POS errors, and transaction irregularities. Payment Handling and Security Accept and process only company-approved payment methods. Follow prescribed procedures for cash, card, electronic wallet, and other authorized payment transactions. Verify payment completion before releasing merchandise. Safeguard cash, payment records, and assigned cashiering equipment. Prevent unauthorized access to POS accounts, cash drawers, and transaction records. Report suspected fraudulent transactions or payment irregularities. Customer Checkout Experience Greet and acknowledge customers courteously at the checkout counter. Process transactions with accuracy and reasonable efficiency. Explain payment, exchange, and other relevant policies clearly and respectfully. Address routine checkout inquiries and refer disputed matters to the Store Head. Thank customers sincerely and conclude transactions with the brand's customer service standards. Merchandise Verification and Packing Verify that all merchandise presented for payment has been correctly recorded in the transaction. Check merchandise condition and confirm that the correct items and quantities are released. Remove security tags or other applicable security devices following approved procedures. jobs.title: Customer Sales Associate, SM City Bicutan
jobs.description: We are looking for a Customer Sales Associate to provide attentive, knowledgeable, and personalized customer service. This position will be reporting to work at SM CIty Bicutan. You will report directly to the Store Supervisor. Key responsibilities: Customer Engagement and Service Delivery Welcome and acknowledge customers in a warm, respectful, and professional manner. Observe customer behaviour and offer assistance at an appropriate time without creating unnecessary pressure Understand customer needs through relevant questions and active listening. Assist customers in identifying suitable products based on preferences, occasion, size, and availability. Maintain a helpful and respectful approach throughout the customer journey. Handle routine customer inquiries and refer concerns requiring authorization to the Store Head. Product Knowledge and Merchandise Assistance Maintain working knowledge of current collections, product categories, sizes, styles, features, and available merchandise. Explain product information accurately and avoid unsupported claims. Recommend appropriate complementary products when relevant to customer needs. Assist with product selection, fitting-room requirements, alternative sizes, and styling options. Maintain appropriate customer privacy, comfort, and professional boundaries. Sales Productivity Contribute to the achievements of store sales targets through effective customer assistance. Apply customer engagement techniques that support conversion, ATV, UPT, and other approved KPIs. Participate in daily sales briefings and understand assigned productivity objectives. Respond constructively to coaching and implement agreed improvements. Balance sales productivity with the brand’s non-hard-selling service philosophy. Selling-Floor and Merchandise Standards Maintain cleanliness, orderliness, and presentation of assigned selling areas. Replenish merchandise and maintain correct product placements, size arrangement, and display standards. Ensure

jobs.title: Head of Marketing Ai Enabled Marketing
jobs.description: At Sprout, we're rebuilding our marketing operating model around that reality. We're looking for an Associate Director, Growth & AI-Enabled Marketing to lead our Marketing Communications organization—and own the business outcome that matters most: turning inbound demand into qualified opportunities and pipeline. What you'll own The inbound growth engine. You'll be accountable for how marketing-generated demand progresses from inbound lead → MQL → SQL → pipeline. That means understanding where demand comes from, where we're losing it, what converts, what doesn't, and what we should stop, fix, test, or scale next. You'll directly own paid media strategy and performance across paid search, paid social, retargeting, and other relevant acquisition channels. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll be expected to understand and challenge campaign structure, audiences, keywords, creative, offers, bidding, landing pages, conversion, and spend allocation. We will still care about impressions, clicks, CTR, and CPC—but as diagnostic metrics, not the finish line. Success is ultimately measured through qualified demand, MQLs, SQLs, pipeline contribution, conversion, and acquisition efficiency. You'll also lead integrated demand generation across paid media, SEO/AEO, web, content, social, events, and other relevant channels, working closely with Product Marketing to turn ICPs, positioning, messaging, product priorities, and GTM strategy into programs that create qualified demand. What you'll build A more AI-enabled marketing organization. We're not looking for someone who has simply used generative AI to write copy or speed up individual tasks. We want someone excited about redesigning how marketing gets done because AI now exists. You'll lead MarCom's part of Sprout's next marketing operating model—using AI agents, automation, reusable workflows, and modern marketing technology to scale: - Paid media execution and optimization - SEO/AEO and search execution - Content creation,

You’ll manage and optimize integrated campaigns across paid search, paid social, display, SEO, email, and retargeting to drive qualified leads, conversions, and marketing ROI. Plan and Execute Digital Campaigns Develop and manage campaigns across Google Ads, Bing, Meta, TikTok, and other relevant platforms. Support SEO, keyword research, email marketing, audience segmentation, and retargeting initiatives. Ensure campaigns align with business goals, timelines, and budgets. 2. Optimize Campaigns Through Testing Monitor and improve campaign performance based on ROI, CPL, CPA, CPC, and conversion rates. Design, execute, and analyze A/B tests on ad creatives, copy, landing pages, audience segments, and campaign strategies. Use test results and data-driven experiments to identify winning variations and continuously improve conversion rates. Optimize bidding strategies, targeting, and creative assets to maximize performance. 3. Manage Budgets and Marketing ROI Allocate and monitor advertising budgets across channels. Adjust spending based on campaign results, channel effectiveness, and business priorities. 4. Collaborate with creative and marketing teams to develop compelling messaging and campaign assets. 5.
